sentences.text: Shri G.P. Singh, learned counsel for the applicant.
Ms. Mamta Shandilya, learned Govt. Advocate for the non-  applicant/State  Heard on the question of admission.

The revision contains arguable points and accordingly  admitted for hearing.
 Record of the Court below be requisitioned.

He is also heard on IA No.7832/2021, which is first application  filed under section 397 (1) of the Cr.P.C for suspension of sentence  of applicant, who has been convicted under section 7(i) r/w Section  16 (1) (A) (I) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced  to undergo 6 months RI. with fine of Rs.1,000/- with default  stipulation.

Considering the nature of accusation and period of custody  coupled with the fact that final hearing of this revision is not possible  in near future during this pandemic era, I deem it proper to suspend  the remaining jail sentence of the applicant, therefore, IA  No.7832/2021 is allowed.

The execution of jail sentence of  applicant is hereby suspended and it is ordered that the applicant be  released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of  Rs.30,000/- (Rs. Thirty Thousand) with one solvent surety of the  like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with a further  direction to appear before the Trial Court, Dewas, District -  Dewas(M.P.) on 15.11.2021 and also on such other dates, as may  be fixed by the trial Court, Dewas District - Dewas in this regard  during the pendency of this revision.
